steps.sql: UPDATE t SET name = ISNULL(b.label, 'none') FROM items t LEFT JOIN (foo s JOIN bar b ON b.id = s.other) ON s.id = t.id; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
SELECT id, value, name FROM items ORDER BY id;

UPDATE t SET value = ISNULL(x.v, 0) FROM items t OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) s.value AS v FROM foo s WHERE s.id = t.id ORDER BY s.value DESC) x; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
SELECT id, value, name FROM items ORDER BY id;

DELETE t FROM items t OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP (1) s.id FROM foo s WHERE s.id = t.id) x WHERE x.id IS NULL; SELECT @@ROWCOUNT AS row_count;
